thread:
sally_support: FYI - multiple customers reporting 502/504s and client timeouts hitting /v1/generate since ~09:12 UTC. Support tickets linked: #4221 #4223. Creating incident standup here.

alex_oncall: Ack — standing up. Adding basic triage: which region, which gateway?

sally_support: Mostly us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Affected routes look like hosted-inference default route and streaming. Error samples attached in tickets (request ids included).

maya_prodeng: Jumping in. Quick metric check: gateway 5xx rate spiked at 09:14, p95 response latency for gateway jumped from 220ms to 3.1s. Backend runtime nodes show growing queue_depth on inference-batcher.

liam_runtime: Repro attempt: small curl against /v1/generate returns 502 with body: "upstream error: read timeout". Log snippet: 
```
[09:15:42] request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate -> batcher queue depth 78 -> runtime worker busy -> upstream timeout
```

ingrid_sre: Noted. Checking infra: no recent autoscaler events, but a large customer appears to have pushed very large embedding/batch requests around 09:10 which likely starved the batcher.

sally_support: That customer is on shared hosted. Support flagged them to pause while we mitigate. They say it was an offline job, batching ~2k sequences.

alex_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) throttle large client at edge (rate-limit by client-id), 2) spin up extra batcher workers in us-west-2 and eu-west-1, 3) enable fallback small-model variant for streaming endpoints to reduce per-token time. I'll run 1 and 2 now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by alex_oncall: scale inference-batcher +3 replicas (canary).

alex_oncall: Throttle rule pushed (client-id: acme-offline) => limit 10 concurrent requests. Watching for effect.

maya_prodeng: After throttle, queue_depth dropped to <10 in 4m, gateway 5xx rate falling. Starting controlled increase to keep latency stable.

liam_runtime: Pushed a runtime config change to reduce per-batch max_size for shared pools (temporarily 512 -> 256) to avoid huge spikes. Rolling patch complete in us-west-2.

ops-bot: autoscaler event: added 3 inference-batcher pods in us-west-2 at 09:23 UTC.

ingrid_sre: Customer-facing note: support team sent initial message. Can we provide ETA for full recovery?

sally_support: Communicated that we mitigated the immediate surge and are investigating root cause; will follow up with timeline and postmortem.

maya_prodeng: Root cause hypothesis: large offline batch from a shared tenant saturated batcher and triggered upstream timeouts; lack of per-customer concurrency caps on hosted default pools made impact cluster-wide. Secondary factor: KV cache cold-start for some model variants increased runtime latency during churn.

liam_runtime: Evidence: runtime traces show sudden KV miss rate jump at 09:11 causing extra round-trips and higher service time per request. When combined with oversized batches, latency amplified and circuit-breakers opened.

alex_oncall: Immediate followups (short list):
- enforce per-customer concurrency and batch-size caps on hosted default pool (owner: maya_prodeng)
- add an emergency rate-limit knob in support console (owner: sally_support)
- add warmup lighting job to keep KV caches hot during scale events (owner: liam_runtime)
- improve alert thresholds to trigger before queue_depth hits 50 (owner: ingrid_sre)

maya_prodeng: Agree. Also will add an automated fallback policy to route large requests to a dedicated throttled pool or smaller model instead of shared.

liam_runtime: I'll create a small regression test that simulates a 2k sequence batch to measure batcher behavior and ensure safeguards.

ingrid_sre: Action item: tune SLO alerts so paging thresholds happen earlier; create an internal runbook entry for large-batch mitigation.

sally_support: I'll coordinate customer comms and update tickets. Support to offer workaround: schedule large offline jobs to a dedicated quota or request reserved capacity.

maya_prodeng: Suggested postmortem owner: maya_prodeng. Proposed timeline: initial draft in 48h, full postmortem in 5 days with RCA, timeline, and remediation plan.

alex_oncall: Closing incident channel in 1h if metrics remain stable. Please add anything else to this thread.

liam_runtime: Note for postmortem: include load-pattern graphs, tracing snippets of KV misses, and the specific batch sizes that triggered the cascade.

sally_support: Thanks all — tickets updated with mitigation steps and ETA.

maya_prodeng: Summary of action items (DM me if assigned elsewhere):
- per-customer concurrency caps (P0)
- emergency rate-limit control in support UI (P1)
- KV cache warmup + regression test (P1)
- alert tuning and runbook update (P1)
- customer comms and guidance doc for large offline jobs (P2)

ingrid_sre: Adding calendar invite for postmortem review in 5 days.

alex_oncall: Good job team. Reopen if any regression. :thumbsup:
